name: Notoriety: A PAYDAY® Experience
desc:
Notoriety: A PAYDAY® Experience is a fast-paced, first person co-op shooter that allows you to join the Notorious crew in planning and executing their next big heist.

HOW TO PLAY:
Upon joining, click the "PLAY" button which takes you to a list of public heists. You're also able to start your own heist from there.
Press [TAB] (Keyboard) or [SELECT] (Controller), or the gear icon (Mobile) when you're in the heist to view controls.

Players with Roblox Premium receive an exclusive suit, armor, and mask! 💎

Version 3.20.2 - Halloween!
- 👻Trick Or Treat heist updated to include a boss fight!
- 🕸️Newly obtainable SPOOKY cosmetics
- ✨Bug fixes and improvements

Tags: Heist, Stealth, FPS, Strategy
